summary: Practise complaint investigation, service recovery, and KPI reporting using ISO guidance and realistic case exercises. View the five-day course outline.
lede: Complaint management training helps customer service, contact-centre, quality, and operations professionals investigate cases and select proportionate remedies. Participants practise complaint classification, root-cause analysis, escalation decisions, and service-quality review, using guidance from ISO 10002:2018 and the SERVQUAL model. They also work with Excel complaint data to report service measures and assess remedy effectiveness, while learning how AI-assisted triage can be checked through human review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle customer complaints, authorize service recovery, or use complaint evidence to improve customer-facing operations. This course is designed for: Complaint-handling officers who investigate cases and document resolution decisions. Customer service supervisors who review escalations and authorize service remedies. Contact-centre team leaders who monitor complaint queues and response commitments. Customer experience analysts who classify complaint themes and report service trends. Quality assurance specialists who audit complaint records against handling procedures. Service recovery specialists who coordinate remedies after service failures. CRM administrators who maintain complaint categories, workflows, and case data. Consumer affairs officers who prepare complaint responses and escalation files. Operations managers who address recurring complaints across customer-facing teams. Product and service managers who prioritize fixes based on complaint evidence.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with customer service operations or routine complaint handling is recommended. No coding or programming is required; basic spreadsheet use will support the Excel-based exercises.
